description: OWNER DECISION (2026-08-31): HOLD -- the script stays until we are done with it. Wired as blocked by fz-kdt.101 and fz-kdt.102, the two open tickets that still name canon movement as their instrument; it surfaces for removal when they close. Removal ticket for fz-kdt.94's scaffolding (the price of adding it, per house rule): when this unblocks and fires, DELETE tools/canon-gate.sh and any doc references in the same motion. If a permanent lightweight equivalent seems warranted then, that is a NEW decision with its own ticket -- do not silently promote the scaffold.
title: Retire the cross-version canon gate script when the artifact-neutrality crackdown ends
